source.classification: already viewed development history; no independent confirmation

question: Does one fixed smooth volatility cap improve the frozen discrete EMA gate joint depth/duration outcome, and does it add anything beyond a simple lower-exposure EMA?

rules.ema: Prior completed close EMA50>EMA200; full nominal1 when true else0; adjust=False, min_periods50/200; unchanged saved rule.
rules.half_ema: Same EMA eligibility; target0.5 when eligible else0. New matched sizing control, not the saved half_hold rule.
rules.discrete_ema: Frozen price-peak ablation from parent plan: set drawdown feature0 in original state recurrence, retaining EMA, sigma20, all thresholds/confirmations/caps. Do not simplify it by name.
rules.continuous_ema: Same EMA eligibility; target=min(1,0.20/sigma20) when eligible and sigma20>0 else0; sigma20=sample std(ddof1) of20 raw-close simple returns * sqrt252. One lag to next open. Valid zero volatility gives0; invalid/nonfinite after warmup fails preflight/stops execution. No state hysteresis, price-peak input, color-triggered caps or fitted parameters.

interpretation: EMA vs continuous changes only sizing. Discrete vs continuous replaces the entire cap policy, including its memory; cannot attribute differences solely to color discretization. 20% is prior agent proposal, not a tuned budget, forecast return or approved risk limit. Inverse volatility, not paper inverse variance.
model_overrides_by_case: Only cost_bps5/10 and target rule; all other financial-model parameters unchanged. Nominal exposure1, no intended borrowing/shorts,99% reserve, daily whole-share targets after modeled costs,USD1 per nonzero trade, zero credit interest. Ex-date cash credit retained as stylized fixture assumption; not payment-date cash or broker parity.

primary_claim.criterion: At each cost, longest observed peak-to-recovery/observed-end duration strictly shorter and maximum drawdown magnitude no worse (fraction tolerance1e-10); require both costs. Failure at either cost rejects this specified historical claim; invalid evidence means unassessed, not a financial rejection.

simplicity_check.criterion: Same-context full-path vector netCAGR maximize, MDD magnitude minimize, duration minimize. If half_ema no worse on all3 and strictly better on1 at both costs, retire added-complexity claim for continuous. Equality is no evidence to prefer complexity. Mixed results tradeoff/inconclusive; no scalar tie-break.

growth: Report net CAGR/wealth gaps versus all controls; acceptable sacrifice unset, so path pass is not investment selection. Sharpe/Calmar diagnostic, never rescue primary failure.
